text.tspan: CO₂ emissions per capita vs. fossil fuel consumption per capita 2025
Fossil fuel consumption is measured as the average consumption of energy from coal, oil and gas per person.
Fossil fuel and industry emissions are included. Land-use change emissions are not included.
Per capita energy from fossil fuels (kilowatt-hours per person; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Per capita emissions (tonnes per person; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
